lines.hook: It's fine to charge your e-bike in a freezing garage. Right? Myth.
lines.why: Below zero Celsius, lithium plates onto the anode as metal. That damage is permanent.
lines.range: Charge between zero and forty-five degrees. Ten to thirty is best. Below freezing, don't charge at all.
lines.do: Bring the battery inside, let it warm up, then charge.
lines.outro: Send this to someone who rides all winter.
